about: The developer's OAuth client IDs (public by design; PLAN.md §5.3, §6.1). Every frame's project allows the Google/Apple ones for ID-token sign-in; the Supabase OAuth App lets the setup wizard reach an owner's Supabase account (its secret lives only in the Cloudflare Worker). The app has the same IDs in app/lib/config/app_config.dart. Google Cloud project: ink-frame-510506.
